page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top, centred, with the page number at top right. Below the text: signature "Bb 4" at left and catchword "diaris" at right. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: strantia : sed hæc sunt Postulatis tuis satis
superqve, jamqve Epistolæ modum lon-
ge supergressi sumus ; velim autem, eru-
ditissime Buxtorfi, accipias à me ista, non
ut decretorie dicta. Feram facile, qvi ali-
ter senserit, licet caducis admodum rati-
onibus niti mihi videatur.
Natura non
possumus non amare opus qvod excolui-mus, & amanti τὰ μὴ
καλὰ, καλὰ πειράντα, hæc περιλήψις[?] exuat animum suum
necesse est eum, qvi oppositæ sici sententiæ
refutationem aggreditur, alioqvin id,
qvod adversarius asserit, capere vix po-
test, nedum refutare. Licet ea, qvæ retu-
li, videantur mihi admodum perspicua,
omnemqve solutionis ansam præripere,
amico tamen animo ea refutantem, non
modo facile feram, sed etiam de me bene
mereri existimabo.
Falli possum &
nonnunqvam expertus sum, ea qvæ judi-
cabam admodum perspicua, aliter se ha-
buisse.
Allatas rationes si in libro, cu-
jus editionem paras, dissolveris, & mihi
& aliis multis magnum operæ pretium
feceris : Hoc vero si irrito canatu aggre-

page.notes: The first word is a fragment carried over from the previous page; its first letter is a damaged ligature, read here as "s". The Greek "πειράντα" and the word "περιλήψις" are uncertain from the scan, marked [?]. "canatu" is printed as it appears; it is probably a printing error for "conatu". The word "aggre-" is broken at the line end and continues on the next page as "diaris".
